VEMPALI PAVAN K

Senior Consultant | Senior Business Analyst | Fraud Risk & FinCrime Specialist


📧  vempalipawankumar@gmail.com   |   📱 +91-9700052819   |   📍 India

PROFESSIONAL SUMMARY

Dynamic and results-driven Business Analyst & Fraud Risk expert with 15+ years’ experience across Banking, Financial Crime Control, Identity & Access Management, Digital Products, Data Platforms & Mobile Apps. Proven record leading business analysis, fraud prevention, solution delivery, migration programs, UAT, stakeholder management & Agile execution. Strong ability to translate business needs into actionable user stories, optimize processes, and deliver value across cross-functional teams.

Core strengths include Gap Analysis, BRD/FRD/User Stories, Payments Messaging, SWIFT, ISO 20022, AML, Financial Crime operations, Data Migration, Fraud Detection, Process Transformation, CI/CD support, UAT, and Agile leadership.


CORE COMPETENCIES & Skills

Business Analysis & Documentation -Requirements Elicitation, BRD/FRD, Wireframes, Acceptance Criteria

BRD/FRD/User Stories, Process Mapping (AS-IS/TO-BE), GAP Analysis, RTM

Agile/Scrum Delivery - Agile Scrum, Story Grooming, Sprint Planning & UAT

Data Analysis, SQL Basics, CI/CD Collaboration, Fraud & Risk Controls

Stakeholder & Client Management, SPOC for Dev/QA/NFT teams

Test Strategy, UAT & Defect Triage

Product Backlog Management & Prioritization

Dashboard & Reporting (Smartsheet’s, Excel, Jira)

Data & Fraud Intelligence, UAT & Test Governance, Stakeholder & Client Management

Process Optimization, AML/KYC & Financial Crime Controls, Regulatory Compliance Awareness

TOOLS & PLATFORMS

JIRA | Confluence | AHA | SAS | Salesforce | Postman | DevOps | GitHub | Lucidchart | Visio | MS Office | Smartsheets



PROFESSIONAL EXPERIENCE:

S2Tech – Senior Business Analyst – Product (C2H)

US Medicaid System -  Bluecompass (April 7th until 30th June 2025)


NTT DATA – Senior Consultant (2022–2025)

Mastercard – Data Feed Manager Platform

Domain: Real-Time Payment Data & Financial Crime Platform

Defined Epics/User Stories & Acceptance Criteria; maintained backlog health

Led AS-IS/TO-BE gap analysis to improve data delivery standards

Supported real-time transaction data delivery (<1-sec SLA) for Financial Crime systems

Collaborated with engineering & product on mockups, data workflows & API behaviors

UAT planning; reviewed test cases, automation monitoring & regression suite

Conducted triage & fix planning; ensured story readiness & delivery value

– Led gap analysis & user stories for Financial Crime transaction pipeline

– Enabled <1 sec real‑time financial event streaming to risk engines

– Governed UAT, automation cycles & defect triage

Impact: Improved delivery quality, reduced backlog redundancy, strengthened fraud data pipeline governance.

Bank of America – IAM

Collected business & security requirements across IT & compliance stakeholders

Prepared BRD/FRD, Use Cases & IAM workflows, supported process improvement

Drove compliance alignment, risk mitigation & change communication

Facilitated adoption & user training support

– Gathered IAM & compliance requirements, designed access flows

– Delivered BRD/FRD & mapped authorization journeys

British Telecom – B2B Mobile Migration (Flutter)

Led requirement discovery & documentation for Mobile UX revamp

Roche – SAP HANA PMO

Managed resource planning, cost forecasting & budget control

Built dashboards; streamlined vendor utilization & reporting

Resolved conflicts & optimized delivery staffing strategies

   Planned global resources, budget cycles, vendor utilization dashboards



Other Projects - (Freelancing on Sabbatical leave, Oct 2021till March 2022)

Accion Labs

Bravvox Social Platform (Web/Mobile)

Led BA functions: UML Diagrams, Mockups, Feature backlog, UAT

Right to Bear – Insurance Portal

Market research, competitor benchmarking, policy segment design

End-to-end BA support for customer journeys & billing flows


HSBC – 2007 to 2022

Senior Fraud Officer (Business Analyst)– | 2017–2022

Conduct interviews, workshops, and surveys with compliance officers and domain experts to gather comprehensive business requirements. This includes defining functional requirements (Example : specific transaction monitoring scenarios, alert generation logic) and non-functional requirements (Example security, performance, reliability).

Worked in Transaction Monitoring Application Development (TMA)

Identify Improvements and Analyze user feedback and monitoring results to identify areas for improvement and propose enhancements or new scenarios for future development cycles

Quality Analyst & Trainer – Fraud Operations | 2013–2017

Conducted quality audits, coaching & operational governance

Supported BA & Ops for process improvements & compliance updates

Performed quality audit on New developed application RISKFORT which performs KYC/AML reviews & customer profiling to prevent Financial Crime.

Senior Fraud Officer – Investigations | 2009–2013

Managed fraud cases, background validations & financial crime assessments on SAS (Transaction monitoring application).

Fraud Detection Analyst | 2007–2009

Monitoring alerts, verify transactions and conducting fraud prevention activities.

HSBC Impact:


Led fraud defense operations across AML, CDD, scam detection, KYC, and risk controls, And Development of Transaction Monitoring Application contributing to safe banking, reducing fraud losses, and ensuring superior customer service.



KEY ACHIEVEMENTS :


Cut delivery timelines in a quarter Accelerated delivery timelines through sprint optimization

Led migration from Falcon to SAS –  Led Falcon → SAS migration for fraud intelligence uplift

Created enterprise RTM framework improving traceability, QA control and Defect management

🏆 Superstar, Top Performer, 100% Quality Award, Extra‑Miler

SOFT SKILLS & CERTIFICATIONS

Generative AI white Belt and Yellow Belt Certified.

Excellent communication & stakeholder management

Critical thinking, problem solving, decision making

Agile collaboration, leadership, conflict resolution

Training, coaching & cross-team orchestration

INTERESTS

Product innovation • Process Optimization, Generative AI • Financial Crime Intelligence • Data Culture

EDUCATION


MBA– Risk Management (ISTM-Distance certification)

B.Com (Computers) – Andhra University
